SearchCourseEnrollments 通过 GET /api/search-course-enrollments 查询至少有一条 ACTIVE 报名的课程，每门课只出现一次，且 ACTIVE 必须属于这门课本身；只有 CANCELLED 或没有报名的课程不入选，按 code 升序分页。每项返回 id、code、name、capacity、doubledCapacity 及 enrollments，doubledCapacity 为该课 capacity 的两倍；enrollments 包含该课全部报名而不只 ACTIVE，按报名 id 升序且不截断，30 条也全部返回；报名含 id、status、active、student，active 表示自身 status 是否 ACTIVE，student 含 id、studentNo、name、label，label 等于该学生 name，不能串用其他课程或学生的值。响应为 total、page、size、records，total 统计匹配课程数而非报名数；page、size 默认 1、20，范围为 1～10000 和 1～100，超过末页为 200 空 records 且保留真实 total，page=0 返回 400 InvalidPage。一次有课程结果的请求恰好执行 4 次业务表读取：总数、当前页、按本页课程编号集合批量读报名、按所需学生编号集合批量读学生；空页只执行前 2 次，非法分页不读取业务表；不能逐门课或逐名学生额外读取，其他读取只能是连接会话变量探测。数据库中课程筛选必须体现与当前课程关联的存在性检查，报名和学生批量读取必须按已取得的编号集合筛选；一次请求的全部读取必须处于同一个只读事务，查询不得改变任何表。返回完整的 sir 0.3 文档，不要 Java、SQL 或解释。

固定接口合同：
{
  "capabilities": [
    "SearchCourseEnrollments"
  ],
  "computed_capacity_factor": 2,
  "course_response": [
    "id",
    "code",
    "name",
    "capacity",
    "doubledCapacity",
    "enrollments"
  ],
  "declared_errors": {
    "InvalidPage": 400
  },
  "enrollment_response": [
    "id",
    "student",
    "status",
    "active"
  ],
  "entities": [
    "Student",
    "Course",
    "Enrollment"
  ],
  "enums": {
    "EnrollmentStatus": [
      "ACTIVE",
      "CANCELLED"
    ]
  },
  "interfaces": {
    "SearchCourseEnrollments": {
      "record_fields": [
        "id",
        "code",
        "name",
        "capacity",
        "doubledCapacity",
        "enrollments"
      ],
      "request_fields": [
        "page",
        "size"
      ],
      "response_fields": [
        "total",
        "page",
        "size",
        "records"
      ],
      "route": "GET /api/search-course-enrollments"
    }
  },
  "namespace": "com.example.courseenrollment",
  "page_default": 1,
  "page_max": 10000,
  "page_min": 1,
  "page_response": [
    "total",
    "page",
    "size",
    "records"
  ],
  "paging": {
    "page_default": 1,
    "page_range": [
      1,
      10000
    ],
    "request": [
      "page",
      "size"
    ],
    "response": [
      "total",
      "page",
      "size",
      "records"
    ],
    "size_default": 20,
    "size_range": [
      1,
      100
    ]
  },
  "readiness": "GET /api/search-course-enrollments?page=1&size=10",
  "request": [
    "page",
    "size"
  ],
  "size_default": 20,
  "size_max": 100,
  "size_min": 1,
  "student_response": [
    "id",
    "studentNo",
    "name",
    "label"
  ]
}

数据库表结构已经确定（表名、列名须与之对应；SIR 中不写 SQL）：
-- Conformance fixture DDL for the Course Enrollment relation slice (Q11).
--
-- This file is the schema of record for the relation-slice conformance run. The
-- generated application never issues CREATE TABLE: the harness creates the owned
-- schema out of band and then applies exactly this DDL through the control
-- session after selecting the catalog. No `CREATE DATABASE`, no `DROP`, and no
-- `USE` statement appears here.
--
-- The column names and types mirror the generated entity mappings:
--   Course.id          Int64 generated auto -> BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT
--   Course.code        String length(1, 32) -> VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
--   Course.name        String length(1,100) -> VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
--   Course.capacity    Int32 where min(1)   -> INT NOT NULL
--   Student.id         Int64 generated auto -> BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT
--   Student.studentNo  String length(1, 16) -> VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL
--   Student.name       String length(1,100) -> VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
--   Enrollment.id      Int64 generated auto -> BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT
--   Enrollment.course  Ref<Course>          -> course_id BIGINT NOT NULL
--   Enrollment.student Ref<Student>         -> student_id BIGINT NOT NULL
--   Enrollment.status  EnrollmentStatus     -> VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
--
-- The foreign keys are real constraints on purpose: the batch reads join on
-- `course_id` and `student_id`, so a read that used the wrong column would either
-- match nothing or fail here, and the environment is stricter than the generated
-- application assumes.
--
-- `idx_enrollment_course` indexes the column the correlated `EXISTS` and the
-- collection batch read both filter on, so the assertions measure the number of
-- statements rather than an accidental table scan.

CREATE TABLE student (
    id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    student_no VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE course (
    id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    capacity INT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE enrollment (
    id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    course_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    student_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_enrollment_course FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES course (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_enrollment_student FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES student (id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_course ON enrollment (course_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_student ON enrollment (student_id);
